memberdef.name: help_options
memberdef.initializer:
= "Options:
" " --help, -h
" " --verbose | --quiet | --silent
" " --list-tests, --list
" " --reporter=human|tap
" " --output-file=<path>
" " --colour[=always|never|auto], --color[=...]
" " --use-colour=yes|no|auto, --use-color=...
" " --filter=<pattern>
" " Run only the matching names; repeat the option for each
" " nesting level: the first pattern applies to the suite
" " names, the second to the test case names, and each
" " further one to the nested test cases. The patterns use
" " '*' and '?', and '|' separates alternatives.
"

briefdescription.para: The text displayed by --help, after the usage line.

detaileddescription.para: Lists the options recognised by runner_options, one per line, with the description of the --filter levels.

The unnamed namespace gives the helpers internal linkage, so that they are visible only in this translation unit, and cannot conflict with the names of the application or of the other source files of the framework. They are not declared in any header.
It contains help_options, the list of the command line options that --help displays after the usage line.
